title: $10K+ in Trading Profits. 239% Account Growth in 2 Months. All Using AI. Seriously AI trading agent really can change your trading journey
author: ogb-officials
selftext:
I've automated my trading with AI, from Iron Condors and Credit Spreads to Options and Prop Trading. I recently tried using AI for a prop firm challenge for the first time. Passed in just one week! I'm now trading a funded account.

The best part? I don't have to sit watching charts all day. I have AI agent that follows my strategy, manages risk, and executes trades automatically, even while I sleep.

I'm hosting a free LIVE session this Sunday at 7 PM ET to teach you how to set up your own AI trading agent (Claude code or codex works, too). Maybe I can have this every Sunday, let's see. I'll also share my trading strategies, and everyone who attends can get one FREE 1-on-1 setup session with me if they'd like personalized help. 

No coding needed. I'll show you exactly how I set mine up. Let me know if you are interested

Any winning strategy I have found has come from a model trained on fine detail and exists for a small window before one of the big players finds it and pushes me out.
